name: Hundred Hands
summary: Conjures spectral hands that seize and drag creatures.

stats.effect: Spectral hands fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Creatures in the area make a Strength saving throw when it appears and at the start of each of their turns, taking 3d8 Force damage and being dragged up to 10 feet toward the center on a failure, or half as much damage and no movement on a success.
